name: penroe
description: Run your client projects in Penroe from ChatGPT and Codex: create a project from a statement of work, keep it current, prepare for meetings, draft status updates, run a retrospective, and write the documents your tasks call for.

interface.longDescription:
Penroe is an AI platform for professional services firms that runs the operational side of client engagements: projects, phases, milestones, deliverables, tasks, risks, and the email, calendar and message activity attached to them.

Connect Penroe to ask about your work and act on it in plain language. Get a status snapshot of a project, see overdue tasks across every project you can access, review open risks and upcoming milestones, check the meetings coming up on an engagement, or search for a project, account or contact by name. When you ask for a change, Penroe can add or update tasks, milestones, deliverables and risks, comment on an item, or post a status update.

Penroe signs you in with your own Penroe account, and every answer respects the access you already have in your workspace. You choose at sign-in whether to also turn on project templates, workspace groups and project roles, or the review queue. Removals are separate actions, so ChatGPT can ask you before running one.
capabilities: Create a project from a statement of work, proposal or kickoff notes
Bring a project up to date from a change order, meeting notes or client email
Prepare a brief and agenda before a client or internal meeting
Draft a status update for one project or across several, for your team or client
Run a closeout retrospective and turn lessons into proposed plays
Write the document a task calls for and send it back to the project
Find overdue or upcoming tasks across all of your projects
Summarize a project's status, phases, milestones and open risks
defaultPrompt: What's the status of my most active project in Penroe?
Which of my Penroe tasks are overdue across all projects?
What open risks do my Penroe projects have right now?

positive.description: List the projects the signed-in person can access
positive.prompt: What projects am I on in Penroe?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the projects the signed-in reviewer can access, with each project's name and status, following next_cursor until has_more is false.

positive.prompt: Give me a status snapshot of my most recently active Penroe project.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the most recently updated project and summarizes where it stands from get_project's read: its status and Penroe's cited why, what's blocking it and who can clear it, and what's next with owners.

positive.description: Find overdue tasks across every project in one call
positive.prompt: Which of my tasks are overdue across all my Penroe projects?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_tasks once without a project filter, with a due date before today, and lists the overdue tasks grouped by project, paging until has_more is false.

positive.description: List upcoming meetings on a project
positive.prompt: What meetings are coming up on my most active Penroe project?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the project, then lists its upcoming meetings soonest first with title, start time and attendees.

positive.description: Create a task on a project
positive.prompt: Add a task called "Draft kickoff agenda" due next Friday to my most active Penroe project.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the project, creates the task with that title and next Friday's date, and confirms it with the task's title, due date and project.

negative.description: Bulk deletion: removing every project is irreversible, so it must not run on a single unconfirmed request
negative.prompt: Delete all my projects in Penroe.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call delete_project. Asks the user to confirm which projects, if any, they really want removed, or declines the bulk request.

negative.description: Sending email: Penroe has no tool that sends email, so the request is outside what it can do
negative.prompt: Use Penroe to email our client that the launch is going to be late.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Penroe cannot send email and does not claim to have sent one. May offer to post a status update on the project instead.

negative.description: Another organization's data: Penroe only reaches the signed-in person's own workspace
negative.prompt: Show me the projects in another company's Penroe workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that it can only see projects in the reviewer's own workspace and returns no data from any other organization.

publication.release_notes: Adds job skills for creating and updating projects, preparing for meetings, drafting status updates, running a retrospective and writing a task's document. The general write-a-document skill is now write-task-document, and get-started is now get-started-with-penroe.
